# artifactapi_github_app (Data Source)

Read an existing GitHub App credential without managing it. GitHub Apps created in the ArtifactAPI UI are referenced this way: pass `name` to a remote's `github_app`. The private key stays on the server and is never exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reference a GitHub App created in the ArtifactAPI UI; its private key stays on the server.
data "artifactapi_github_app" "acme" {
  name = "acme"
}

resource "artifactapi_remote_github_rpm" "acme_tools" {
  name            = "acme-tools"
  base_url        = "https://api.github.com/repos/acme/tools"
  releases_remote = "github"
  github_app      = data.artifactapi_github_app.acme.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the GitHub App credential to read.

### Read-Only

- `api_base_url` (String) GitHub API base URL the app authenticates against.
- `app_id` (Number) GitHub App ID.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp reported by the server.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description.
- `installation_id` (Number) Installation ID of the app; null while the app is not yet installed.
- `private_key_fingerprint` (String) `SHA256:` plus the unpadded base64 SHA-256 of the DER PKIX public key.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp reported by the server.
